title: thelypteris nigricans
intro: Thelypteris nigricans, commonly known as Black Spleenwort, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris nigricans include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating infections and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
